title: 着脱式スチールボラード
description: 反射帯、鍵穴、持ち上げループ、基礎ソケットを備える着脱式の車止め。 ゲーム・可視化向け。製造・構造設計・3Dプリント用途は未検証。
descriptionEn: A removable powder-coated steel bollard with socket collar, lift loop, lock and reflector bands. For games and visualization; not validated for manufacture, structural engineering or 3D printing.
author: Xenoah
uv: Original UV coordinates and split normals retained. Tangents are not exported; calculate them in the receiving application.
descriptionScope: Original model purpose and source-format notes; FBX-specific facts and differences are in CONVERSION.json and CONVERSION_NOTES.md.
